hero.subtitle: Enter your startup, get matched 1v1 against similar Georgian products, and let the public decide who ships the best.

howItWorks.step1Body: One startup per account. Registration opens for a single 1-hour window before every tournament.
howItWorks.step2Body: Dynamic seeding pairs 2 to 32 startups into a single-elimination bracket — byes for the top seeds if the field isn't a perfect power of two.
howItWorks.step3Body: Every round runs on a countdown. A 50/50 tie triggers overtime or falls to whoever got the first vote.
howItWorks.step4Body: The winner is showcased on the homepage — logo, tagline, and a link straight to their site.
